authoring_policy: Behavior-only requests may state interfaces, voltage domains, protocol semantics, loading, timing, partial-power, startup, and isolation behavior. They may not state components, packages, pins, nets, topology families, models, coordinates, layers, routes, providers, repairs, or expected architecture identities.

cases.prompt: Create a 400 kHz bidirectional open-drain control bus between 3.3 V and 1.8 V domains. Either domain may be unpowered, the bus load is at most 80 pF, and rise time must not exceed 300 ns.

Connect six independently isolatable 3.3 V SMBus branches to a 1.8 V controller trunk at 1 MHz. The aggregate load is 360 pF, the trunk is 30 pF, each branch is 55 pF, rise time is 120 ns, and an unpowered branch must not disturb the trunk.

Translate an 8 MHz push-pull synchronous serial link between 1.8 V and 3.3 V. Two lanes travel toward the peripheral, one returns to the controller, startup is inactive, and either side may be unpowered without back-power.
Translate a 2 MHz push-pull asynchronous serial link in both directions between 3.3 V and 1.8 V. Preserve the inactive state at startup and isolate either unpowered side.
